Subject: Post-discovery: scheduling 30-min demo — Redwood Inference + Meridian Bank

Hi Michael —

Thanks again for the time earlier today. Quick recap from my side:
- Main priorities you mentioned: reduce per-token inference cost for high-volume batch jobs, and lower 99th percentile latency for customer-facing chat.
- Key constraints: must integrate with your VPC/private deployment options and meet SOC 2 controls for logging.

Next step I suggested was a 30-minute product demo focused on a) a quick architecture walk-through (private vs dedicated), b) performance numbers for workloads like yours, and c) a short Q&A with our Solutions Engineer.

Two options that work on our side: 
1) Thu, Feb 26 — 13:00–13:30 PT
2) Wed, Mar 3 — 10:00–10:30 PT

If neither works, happy to push to the following week. Could you confirm which option is best and who would attend from your side (I'll invite a Solutions Engineer and account owner)?

I've attached a one-page demo agenda and included a Calendly link if you'd prefer picking a time directly: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/demo-30

Thanks — looking forward to continuing the convo.

Best,
Marissa Cole
